name: polymerge-monorepo
description: Structural diff and three-way merge for 3D models: STL, OBJ, glTF/GLB.

scripts.build: npm run build -w polymerge-core && npm run build -w @joshuahurley/polymerge && npm run build -w @polymerge/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w polymerge-core && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && tsc -p action/tsconfig.json
scripts.e2e: node apps/web/e2e/smoke.mjs && node scripts/e2e-view.mjs && node scripts/e2e-worker.mjs && node scripts/e2e-merge.mjs && node scripts/e2e-git.mjs && node scripts/e2e-action.mjs && node scripts/e2e-pack.mjs
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run e2e
